Frontal System Behavior (FrSBe) Scale

Changes in behavior of all patients were measured by the Frontal System Behavior (FrSBe) Scale ( ), a 46-item behavior rating scale for both patients and caregivers, designed to provide a total frontal disturbance score ( T score) and 3 subscale scores (or subscores) that allow to assess apathy, disinhibition, and executive dysfunction.

description.value: The Frontal System Behavior Scale was administered to all patients to quantify behavioral changes over time using total frontal disturbance T scores and apathy, disinhibition, and executive dysfunction subscores; caregiver current-time scores were used, with T > 65 indicating impaired behavior and executive functions.

spans.text: It quantifies behavioral changes over time by combining retrospective and current assessments of frontal dysfunction ( T > 65 is defined as impaired behavior and executive functions).

search_volume.value: Inclusive mask formed from the union of the three single-group RSN maps; exact volume not reported.

specific_metric.value: Within-network resting-state fMRI signal fluctuations/connectivity derived from independent component analysis.

spans.text: For each single subject, 40 independent components were extracted (corresponding to 1/6th of the number of time points) ( ) and scaled to spatial z scores (i.e., the number of standard deviations of their whole-brain spatial distribution).

source_definition.value: Subject group comprising ALS patients, bvFTD patients, and healthy controls.

model_settings.value: Forty independent components were extracted per subject; individual component maps were clustered by mutual whole-brain spatial similarity using self-organizing group ICA, and maps within each cluster were averaged to generate group components. Artifact-related components were removed after visual inspection.

estimator.value: Independent component analysis using the fast ICA algorithm and self-organizing group ICA.

software.value: BrainVoyager QX, using plug-in extensions implementing fast ICA and self-organizing group ICA.

value: Temporal high-pass filtering at 3 cycles per time course
Talairach normalization using a 12-parameter affine transformation
Spatial smoothing with a 6-mm FWHM isotropic Gaussian kernel

description.value: Preprocessed resting-state fMRI time series using BrainVoyager QX: slice-timing correction, six-parameter rigid-body motion correction, temporal high-pass filtering with a cutoff of 3 cycles per time course, coregistration and Talairach normalization using a 12-parameter affine transformation with resampling to a 3-mm isometric grid, and spatial smoothing with a 6-mm FWHM isotropic Gaussian kernel.

spans.text: With regard to functional MRI (fMRI), only a few studies, exploring the whole-brain functional connectivity of the resting state (RS) (i.e., RS-fMRI, ), have been carried out in ALS ( ) and bvFTD patients ( ).

description.value: Participants stayed motionless, awake, and relaxed with eyes closed; no visual or auditory stimuli were presented.

instructions.value: Participants were asked to stay motionless, awake, and relaxed and to keep their eyes closed.

stimuli.value: No visual or auditory stimuli were presented during functional scanning.
